sentences.span: we observed lower crude prices relative to refined products
sentences.why: The note's thesis throughout ('the increasing disconnect between crude oil and diesel markets as exceptional product tightness', 'Diesel says Brent should be above $150/bbl') is that refined products are pricing tighter than crude.

sentences.span: US diesel and gasoline inventories are at the lowest levels in 15 years
sentences.why: 18126 (GlobalMarkets Weekly Wrap-Up, citing Politico/AAA) separately confirms 'The average price for a gallon of diesel was $6.52 Wednesday, up 91 cents from a month ago' and 'White House is preparing plan for 90-day diesel exports ban'.

sentences.why: Same note continues 'Goldman's broader funds positioning indicator shows an extreme duration underweight, a setup that has historically preceded lower 10-year yields over the following three months.' The $22.7bn notional figure is independently confirmed in 17999 (GS Garrett Weekend Prep): 'US10y @ 99% of max short (-22.7bn)'.
